gaps: Phase: 1 — raw port (still states). Phase 2 wires svelte-motion.
ReactNode → Snippet: `icon` prop and `items[].icon` are now Snippets (documented in .types.ts); recorded as the accepted API delta.

Phase 1 still-state: trigger label morph and gliding highlight render their end states statically; label width tracking already live via ResizeObserver ($effect) so Phase 2 springs it without structural edits. Highlight span stays mounted per DOM-parity rule (React kept it mounted, animating opacity to 0). Focus wiring uses onfocusin (bubbling) because Bits UI focuses items inside Content — DOM focus does not bubble.
Items are keyed by `item.label` exactly as the React original keyed its Fragment; duplicate labels would collide (documented on the `items` prop in .types.ts).
Anatomy coverage: only Root/Trigger/Portal/Content/Item/Separator used — matches source exactly (verified against pipeline/anatomy/dropdown-menu.json, 18 parts exported, 6 consumed).
Motion props (AnimatePresence label morph, spring highlight) intentionally absent in Phase 1; listed for Phase 2 wiring per PORTING-PLAN §6.
